subject: Weekend schedule
text: I’m planning to finish the client report draft on Saturday morning, then spend the afternoon organizing photographs for a small exhibition. Since the spreadsheet still needs several corrections, I will complete those before switching focus, ensuring the figures match the latest invoice details. After that, I will prepare a concise summary for the project coordinator, send it to the shared folder, and close the remaining comments, so the file is ready by Monday. On Sunday, I will visit the library for reference materials, review two article PDFs, and return home before evening to make brief notes. This schedule gives the unfinished task clear time and keeps the rest of the weekend practical. If you happen to know anyone who may be interested in the exhibition, I would be glad to share more details later. Best,
